snippet.title: Stardust Rain - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Stardust Rain will be dropping a new Demo next week! This Demo contains 5 playable fighters, 5 stages, Online Play, and Training Mode.

You can Download the Demo on June 2nd at these sites:

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2634710/Stardust_Rain/

itch.io: https://arcade-hut.itch.io/stardust-rain

GameJolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/stardustrain/793935
